title: What should be the perfect little sauce pan…
text:
What should be the perfect little sauce pan…. During the recent Covid pandemic I purged the kitchen of excess items accumulated over the past 25yr. I like to think of this as my pandemic Silver lining.. afterwards, I aimed to replace with only quality necessities..
‘
Welcome the KOLEX sauce pan!! I loved everything about this online and was happy to incorporate it into my newly vacated cupboard.. I was smitten with the overall aesthetic’s- from the faux wood handle and base looking of a natural stone it is really sleek..

Only problem.. ours came with a few chips/divets: x1 divet into the finish on the handle and X1 chip taken out right from the body of pan itself. (see photos I included.) This is a bit concerning how it will hold up with integrity over time.. All be honest, at this point in the game I want my kitchenware to do more than just look good to move in with me..!! I’m hoping this is an isolated incident that happened in transfer. But, it does tell me this is not indestructible!

Performance: loving temperature control plate on bottom it disperses heat evenly.. no hot spots detected! If being honest, I’m not easy on pot/pans and thus far, no scorching or sticking issues. This presents a baked in layer or coating(?) making it beyond easy to hand wash with hot soapy water.. and still dishwasher safe if desired. Lid is a dream with its safety ridge it lets you move or transfer without worry of sliding off. But, best thing I’ve found.. this unique look.. ans why not!? This is perfect for a pot rack or, serving directly from.. it just makes the task of cooking much more fun! Hoping this info helps your decision- Bon appétit!
